Given $△ABC$ shown above, which of the following diagrams represents the height corresponding to $\overset{―}{BC}?$
worked_solution:
The height (or altitude) corresponding to $\overset{―}{BC}$ is a line segment that 

- runs from the opposite vertex $A$ to the line $\overset{⟷}{BC},$ and

- is perpendicular to $\overset{⟷}{BC}.$

To draw the height, we proceed as follows:

- Extend the line segment $\overset{―}{BC}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945712/assets/26bb0e4cf177eec77164b76cb3b72986977ebe439fe39220ac820d7d3cc2a03b.png)

- Draw the perpendicular from $A$ to $\overset{⟷}{BC}.$
